_comment: Phase 10. Adapted from Hassam's ~/Documents/'WSAI deployment script.sh'. Oneshot runs its OWN vendored copy (scripts/deploy-wsai.sh) so his manual script stays untouched; the vendored copy adds --yes, because the original blocks on `read -r -p 'press Enter to continue'` at line 78 when the branch is already up to date, and under `set -euo pipefail` feeding it /dev/null makes read return 1 and abort the script.
_comment_host: hooks/deploy-guard.js allowlist. A deploy command naming any other host is denied, fail-closed. 172.30.1.64 is VPN-gated, so the reachability breaker must probe it as well as GitLab.
_comment_refs: The ONLY refs phase 10 may deploy. The script deploys the TIP OF A BRANCH, not a SHA — see config/project.json concurrency for why that forces one run at a time.
_comment_verify: The script exits non-zero when the site does not return 200, so the exit code is the primary signal. healthUrl re-checks independently after the script returns: curl BY IP without the Host header returns 400 (ALLOWED_HOSTS), so the Host header is mandatory.
_comment_deps: The script's --npm / --pip flags. Oneshot decides these from ITS OWN diff rather than letting the script probe the server: if the run touched package.json -> --npm, requirements/ -> --pip.
_comment_timeout: Cold builds on that box take ~25 min and the script's own deadline is 45 min, plus a 90s service-stability sleep. 50 min gives it room without letting a wedged build hold the queue forever.
